name: George A. Smith
role: Apostle, cousin of Joseph Smith, and Church historian
dateNote: He was ordained an apostle at Far West on 26 April 1839 and named in section 136 in January 1847.
importance: He marched with Zion’s Camp in 1834 and became a Seventy in 1835. Section 124 lists him among the Twelve. Section 136 tells him and Amasa Lyman to organize a company for the trek west. In Utah he became Church historian and later first counselor to Brigham Young.
connections: Son of John Smith and Clarissa Lyman, which made him Joseph Smith’s first cousin. He served with Amasa Lyman and the other apostles.

sources.title: George A. Smith, Joseph Smith Papers

reviewNote: Birth (26 June 1817, Potsdam, New York), parents, baptism, Zion’s Camp, ordinations, mission, historian, and First Presidency checked on JSP; death date 1 September 1875 shown in a fragment. Cousin relationship inferred from his father John Smith, brother of Joseph Smith Sr.
